posts.text: An AI judge re-graded coding-agent runs on SWE-Bench Pro and disagreed with the test suite on 32.4% of them (67 false positives + 189 false negatives, of 789). On DeepSWE: 1.4% (2 + 8 of 735). If you choose coding agents by leaderboard score, treat the tests as a noisy ruler. Source: DeepSWE paper.
